messages:
carmen: Quick note  saw a 1.9% uptick in unassigned leads during yesterday's peak. Pattern: enrichment callback lag -> assign job writes owner=null.

jude: is this HubSpot only?

carmen: both HS and SF. HS sometimes posts assign before enrichment completes.

sam: quick patch idea: add a 30s "orbit" wait window where we mark lead pending instead of null, then fallback to sdr-overflow.

jude: config sketch?

sam: yep:
```
routing.orbit_window_seconds=30
routing.pending_flag=true
routing.fallback_pool="sdr-overflow"
```

carmen: also add lead property `routing_note=orbit_canary` for SDR visibility and `owner_history` for audits.

jude: observability: emit routing.orbit.wait_ms and routing.unassigned.rate. Alert if unassigned_rate > 1% over 15m.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4601: "orbit handshake canary + SalesOps export" assigned to growth-eng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4601 :white_check_mark:

carmen: I'll PR the HS workflow gate to only call /assign when enrichment_status=complete or orbit expires. Starting 5% canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Will post SalesOps note before kickoff.
